svg.aria-label: Sosyal Stüdyo — Build a flow once; it runs the same way every time. Flows, contacts and scores, bulk messages, growth tools, an AI agent and tools for ideas, scripts, hooks and carousels. Fully usable in local mode; a Worker adds Telegram, Instagram, WhatsApp and AI.

g.text: 16 STEP TYPES · LOCAL MODE WORKS WITHOUT A SERVER
Build a flow once; it runs the same way every time.
Flows, contacts and scores, bulk messages, growth tools, an AI agent
and tools for ideas, scripts, hooks and carousels. Fully usable in local
mode; a Worker adds Telegram, Instagram, WhatsApp and AI.
